newsitem.title: POLAND: Stomil down 9.5 pct on tyre recall news.
newsitem.headline: Stomil down 9.5 pct on tyre recall news.

text.p: Polish tyre maker Stomil Olsztyn SA fell 9.5 percent to 65 zlotys on Wednesday, the day after it announced it was recalling two defective types of passenger car tyres and one type of delivery van tyre, analysts said.
Stomil, 52.1-percent owned by Michelin, said the operation could cost up to 13.6 million zlotys ($4.2 million) and that it would make a financial prosivision in June.
Traders said the fall should slow on Thursday as Wednesday's low 1.3-million-zloty turnover signalled there was no sell-off.
"Maybe smaller Polish investors reacted sharply but more serious investors will probably wait for a more exact explanation," one trader said, referring to the exact costs of the operation.
